title: Archetectural Interior designer
description:

The ideal candidate should be capable of handling interior design projects from concept to execution, coordinating with clients, consultants, and vendors to deliver high\-quality design solutions.

Develop interior design concepts, layouts, and space planning

Prepare detailed drawings, 3D views, and presentations

Work on residential and/or commercial interior projects

Coordinate with architects, contractors, vendors, and site teams

Conduct site visits and ensure design execution as per drawings

Assist in material selection, finishes, and specifications

Ensure projects are completed within timelines and budgets

Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture ,Civil or Interior designing

1–2years of relevant work experience

Good understanding of materials, finishes, and construction details

Strong communication and presentation skills

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a fast\-growing Global SaaS / Software Product company building cutting\-edge solutions in education and faith\-based technologies. Eloit is on a mission to unlock potential through graceful innovation. Our flagship platforms include Edisapp School ERP, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and more, headquartered in London, with over a decade of innovation and operations in Kochi, India.

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for a talented and creative UI Developer with a strong eye for design and a passion for building intuitive, engaging, and user\-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile platforms.

The ideal candidate will combine strong UI/UX design skills with hands\-on frontend development expertise, particularly in Vue.js, to transform user and business requirements into high\-quality digital products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop intuitive, responsive, and visually engaging user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Translate business and user requirements into user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Develop user\-facing applications and reusable UI components using Vue.js.
* Create and maintain design systems, style guides, UI patterns, and reusable design components to ensure consistency across products.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Convert functional requirements and user needs into simple, effective, and aesthetically appealing user experiences.
* Identify, analyse, and resolve UI/UX usability issues through research, testing, and iterative design.
* Create original visual assets, graphics, icons, and other UI elements when required.
* Ensure designs are responsive, accessible, scalable, and optimized for different screen sizes and devices.
* Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and maintain visual consistency between design and production.
* Conduct design reviews and provide guidance on UI/UX best practices.
* Maintain clear documentation of design decisions, workflows, components, and interaction patterns.
* Stay updated with emerging UI/UX trends, frontend technologies, accessibility standards, and design methodologies.

Design and develop UI flows, menus, HUDs, and user\-facing applications that meet defined design goals; create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and supporting documentation; translate business and user requirements into style guides, design systems, design patterns, and attractive, consistent user interfaces; develop and maintain responsive user\-facing applications using Vue.js; create original graphic designs and visual assets where required; and identify, analyse, and troubleshoot UX and usability problems through iterative design and testing.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* Required Skills \& Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in UI development, UI/UX design, frontend development, or a related role.
* Strong proficiency in modern UI/UX design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with Vue.js and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive design, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Good understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, interaction design, and usability.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and reusable UI components.
* Strong understanding of responsive web and mobile design principles.
* Ability to translate designs into functional, production\-ready interfaces.
* Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Good problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Knowledge of REST APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.
* Experience with mobile UI/UX design and mobile\-first design principles.
* Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design.
* Experience working with design tokens and component libraries.
* Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience in designing products for education, ERP, SaaS, or enterprise applications.

**What We Value**

* A strong user\-first mindset.
* Creativity combined with practical problem\-solving.
* Ability to balance design quality, usability, and technical feasibility.
* Ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and experiment with new technologies and design approaches.

**Why Eloit?**

At Eloit, you will not just be doing a job; you will be part of a mission. We build technology that impacts thousands of schools, students, and faith communities across the globe, and every person on our team plays a real role in that story.

We are a decade\-old, London\-headquartered Global SaaS / Software Product company with a passionate team in Kochi, India, building world\-class platforms trusted by 700\+ institutions across 4 continents. We move fast, we build things that matter, and we invest in the people who make it happen.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Day Shift
* Values\-driven and mission\-oriented work culture

Interested candidates should submit a detailed resume and a cover letter explaining why they are a good fit for this role.
